scripts.build:background: varlock run -- bun run --filter rankwrangler-extension build:background
scripts.build:chrome: varlock run -- bun run --filter rankwrangler-extension build:chrome
scripts.build:content: varlock run -- bun run --filter rankwrangler-extension build:content
scripts.build:popup: varlock run -- bun run --filter rankwrangler-extension build:popup
scripts.build:safari: varlock run -- bun run --filter rankwrangler-extension build:safari
scripts.check: bun run check:fast && bun run server:build
scripts.check:fast: bun run env:check && bun run env:contract && bun run test
scripts.cli:build: bun run http-client:build && bun run --filter @rankwrangler/cli build
scripts.cli:test:e2e: bun run cli:build && bun run --filter @rankwrangler/cli test:e2e
scripts.dev: varlock run -- concurrently -k -n server,website -c cyan,magenta "bun run --filter @rankwrangler/server --elide-lines=0 dev" "bun run --filter @rankwrangler/website dev"
scripts.dev:jobs: varlock run -- concurrently -k -n server,website -c cyan,magenta "bun run --filter @rankwrangler/server --elide-lines=0 dev:jobs" "bun run --filter @rankwrangler/website dev"
scripts.extension:build: varlock run -- bun run --filter rankwrangler-extension build
scripts.extension:build:background: varlock run -- bun run --filter rankwrangler-extension build:background
scripts.extension:build:chrome: varlock run -- bun run --filter rankwrangler-extension build:chrome
scripts.extension:build:content: varlock run -- bun run --filter rankwrangler-extension build:content
scripts.extension:build:popup: varlock run -- bun run --filter rankwrangler-extension build:popup
scripts.extension:build:safari: varlock run -- bun run --filter rankwrangler-extension build:safari
scripts.extension:dev: varlock run -- bun run --filter rankwrangler-extension dev
scripts.extension:preview: varlock run -- bun run --filter rankwrangler-extension preview
scripts.extension:start: varlock run -- bun run --filter rankwrangler-extension start
scripts.http-client:build: bun run http-client:types && tsc -p packages/http-client/tsconfig.json && cp packages/http-client/src/app-router.d.ts packages/http-client/dist/app-router.d.ts
scripts.preview:chrome: varlock run -- bun run --filter rankwrangler-extension preview:chrome
scripts.test: bun run http-client:test && bun run extension:test:auth && bun run test:release
